pack: Roblox-owned animation packages (catalog bundles by creator 'Roblox')
count_detail: 18 bundles counted via catalog.roblox.com/v1/search/items/details?Category=12&Subcategory=38&CreatorName=Roblox (all creatorTargetId 1); each bundle holds 7 animation assets (Idle, Walk, Run, Jump, Fall, Climb, Swim) = 126 animation assets. Packs: Toy, Rthro, Ninja, Robot, Werewolf, Superhero, Vampire, Stylish, Zombie, Mage, Cartoony, Oldschool, Levitation, Knight, Pirate, Elder, Bubbly, Astronaut.
licence_words: Roblox-owned (catalog creator 'Roblox', user id 1). Roblox docs: 'You can replace these default animations with animations from the catalog or with your own custom animations.' (create.roblox.com/docs/animation/using)
style: Roblox avatar locomotion sets (R15), themed: toy, ninja, robot, zombie, mage, knight, pirate, etc.
human_made_evidence: Roblox first-party catalog items created 2018-08-14 (Rthro 2018-10-23, Oldschool 2020-07-10), predating generative animation tools.
bulk_download: No files; used by ID. IDs listed by the catalog search API (bundledItems) and stored as a table; applied in-game via HumanoidDescription or the Animate script.
free_tier_only_note: Catalog price (0-1000 Robux) is for avatar ownership; using Roblox-owned animation IDs inside an experience needs no purchase and no upload. Verify playback in Studio once before shipping.

pack: Roblox-owned emotes (catalog EmoteAnimations by creator 'Roblox', unbranded)
count_detail: 80 emotes counted via catalog.roblox.com/v1/search/items/details?Category=12&Subcategory=39&CreatorName=Roblox (all creatorTargetId 1, on-sale listing); 14 excluded as branded third-party IP (Chappell Roan HOT TO GO!, Shrek Roar, 5 Twenty One Pilots, 3 KSI, 4 Royal Blood) -> 66 eligible (e.g. Salute, Hello, Shrug, Point2, Stadium, Tilt, Applaud, Floss Dance, Samba, Cha Cha, Robot, Zombie, Sleep, Agree, Disagree).
licence_words: Roblox-owned (catalog creator 'Roblox'). Roblox docs: 'All users have access to default emotes, such as dance, point, and cheer.' and developers set emotes by catalog ID with HumanoidDescription:SetEmotes / SetEquippedEmotes (create.roblox.com/docs/characters/emotes)
human_made_evidence: Roblox first-party catalog items created 2019-06-24 to 2021-09-12 (counted set), before generative animation tools.
bulk_download: No files; used by ID from the catalog search API listing.
free_tier_only_note: 7 are free in the catalog (Applaud, Shrug, Point2, Hello, Salute, Stadium, Tilt); the rest cost 55-1000 Robux for avatar ownership. The docs show no purchase requirement for a developer granting emotes by ID in their own experience (verify in Studio). Branded emotes are left out because they carry artist or franchise IP.

count_detail: Docs table of default character animations: Run, Walk, Jump, Idle (2 variations), Fall, Swim, Swim (Idle), Climb = 9.
licence_words: 'By default, Roblox player characters include common animations like running, climbing, swimming, and jumping.' (Roblox-owned)
formats: Roblox asset ID inside the default Animate LocalScript
human_made_evidence: Roblox first-party defaults shipped with every avatar.
bulk_download: Present in every place; IDs readable from the Animate script in Studio.
free_tier_only_note: Free, built in; default emotes (wave, point, cheer, dance, laugh) also built in per docs.

pack: Quaternius Universal Animation Library (free Standard tier)
count_detail: itch.io Standard tier image text: '45 completely free animations' (Standard [free] zip 15 MB); full library 120+ (paid Pro $9.99+, Source $14.99+ adds .blend). quaternius.jsonl counted 42 named clips plus 2 root-motion duplicates in the tier image.
duplicate_of: quaternius.jsonl 'Universal Animation Library' (do not add twice to totals)
licence_words: Free to use in personal, educational and commercial projects. (CC0 License); itch 'Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal'
style: humanoid retargetable clips: 8-direction locomotion, jog, sprint, crawl, swim, sit, deaths, melee, guns, emotes
human_made_evidence: Quaternius (Tomas Laulhe); on itch.io by March 2025 (earliest devlog 2025-03-21; v2.0 2026-01-23, v3.0 2026-06-16); itch.io 'No generative AI was used'.
bulk_download: itch.io name-your-own-price $0: one Standard zip (~15 MB).
free_tier_only_note: Only the free Standard tier counted; paid Pro/Source tiers are also CC0 but cost money (owner yes needed).
upload_note: Files must be imported in Studio (Animation Editor FBX import or Blender->R15 retarget) and published to Roblox under the account or group that owns the user's experience; Roblox docs (create.roblox.com/docs/animation/editor): 'If the animation will be used in any group-owned game, select the group from the Creator field.' StudPilot cannot ship playable IDs for these; the user's own account must upload them (owner rule: nothing uploaded to the owner's account without a yes).
